name: What's the difference between a free evaluation and a paid inspection?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a free evaluation and a paid inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our wind damage evaluations are typically free and focused on assessing storm damage for potential repairs or insurance claims. A paid inspection, often done for real estate transactions or routine maintenance, usually involves a more comprehensive report on the overall condition and lifespan of the entire roofing system, beyond just storm-related issues. The choice depends on your immediate need: a free evaluation if you suspect storm damage, or a paid inspection for a broader assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our free evaluations assess storm damage for repairs/claims. Paid inspections offer comprehensive reports for real estate or maintenance, covering overall roof condition.
